# Turnip Tanooki: Washed Up!
An educational and cute game where you answer math questions to obtain fish!

Game made for UQ CS GameJam 2026. Made by myself, and my friends. Our team consisted of 2 programmers, 1 artist, and myself - I worked on programming and other art (item sprites, and music)

This game is based on the Turnip Tanooki character made by my friend (and all the animations in the game were made by her). In particular we were inspired by this artwork:
[![this artwork](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/744c5396-75da-4277-b823-439ce693ce15/dl5yhd2-8e563b4f-43b1-4810-8c1e-31fc93fd7804.jpg/v1/fill/w_1192,h_670,q_70,strp/jothanan_takes_a_vacation_by_laggitylaptop_dl5yhd2-pre.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..r7qQ0GFNPrddQrlGq3HNNV-enrRQry4TE9vsKcry3W0)]([https://www.deviantart.com](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/))
